About us

Make every moment sweeter

Kekiz is a cake shop with two homes, one in Sangli and one in Miraj. We make customised cakes for birthdays, first birthdays, anniversaries and every special moment in between.

Every cake is 100% pure veg and baked fresh. You bring the idea, and we shape it into a cake with your theme, colours and name on it.

We also do customised flowers as gifts, and cake stands are available when you need one.
